description: This file declares the MediaFrameWriterV2 class, which implements the IMediaFrameWriter interface for writing media frames to shared memory. It includes methods for constructing the writer, writing frames, and retrieving the number of frames written. It also defines private members for managing shared memory and metadata building.

classes.name: MediaFrameWriterV2
classes.description: A class responsible for writing media frames into shared memory, building metadata, and tracking the number of frames written.

methods.name: MediaFrameWriterV2
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the writer with a shared memory buffer and associated info.

methods.name: writeFrame
methods.description: Writes a media segment to shared memory and updates internal counters.

methods.name: getNumFrames
methods.description: Returns the number of frames written so far.

methods.name: buildMetadata
methods.description: Builds a metadata protobuf object from a media segment; may throw exceptions.
